title: A/R Collection: a column where every row is the same does not reorder
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in this report at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with three overdue invoices on today's date, invoice A, invoice B and invoice C, all at location A; in number order they read A, B, C.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The group shows the three invoices, each with Location A.

Step 2:

  • The Location column is marked as sorted, but nothing visibly moves inside the group: every row has the same value.
  • The three invoices stay ordered by number: invoice A, invoice B, invoice C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-E1: “A column where every row has the same value (for example Location when each customer has one location) shows no visible change; the tie-break (S2-R4) still applies.”
  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The first click puts the smallest number first and the second click the largest first. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort, always smallest document number first: reversing a sort reverses the sorted column only, so tied rows keep that order in both directions. A date column compares the day only, never the time of day, so two rows on the same date are a tie.”
